means: One constructed replay per 欄干 build board the planner can build: from an empty board, the page's grey terrain built out of pieces WE chose, then the page's own pieces (the L stood on end, shifted one column, and the roof), then the flat T into the window the corpus matcher reads, a TSD that opens the well under its left arm. Run through the vendored Triangle engine. A board the planner cannot build is published unbuilt with its measured reason.
not_eligible_because: constructed, not played: the queue, the hold and the key inputs are ours, and the terrain's pieces are ours too (the page draws it grey). No claim id, no badge, no figure in any count.
caveat: the page draws its terrains grey; a demo stands only on what the planner can build from an empty board without clearing a line, and fires the TSD variant as drawn. It ends on the TSD: the page draws its well two deep, so there is no Tetris to construct, and the TSS on the same board is not a second demo (one demo per board).
rules: a demo starts from an empty board, as every decoder does; the terrain is an exact cover of its grey cells by pieces the planner chose, every one reachable from spawn by the engine's own moves, no line cleared
the page's own pieces are the build board's lower-case letters, one whole piece per letter
the flat T is the one T placement at which the corpus window (technique-facts.ts windowMatch, as drawn) matches the build board, and must be credited a full T-spin clearing the variant's lines
a variant with a payoff in place of a follow-up ends the demo on the stood T
the engine is the arbiter: every lock must land where the plan put it, with its spin, lines and hold flag
